text:
Entry visa can be done in Tel Aviv South, subject to a scheudled meeting. You can apply for a meeting via their email, or through this link here: https://www.gov.il/he/service/schedule_meeting_visas_department (for other readers, this link is not relevant for partner visas, please don't try to use it).

In TLV center you can go without a meeting as far as I know, but expect long waiting times.
